payment_structure.mandatory_advance: 50% of the total project value is required to initiate production.
payment_structure.final_payment: Remaining balance due upon project completion and prior to final asset handover.

refund_policy.pre_confirmation: If the project is cancelled before official confirmation, a refund equivalent to 25% of the total project price is available.
refund_policy.post_confirmation: Once the project is confirmed and production begins, no refunds are issued.
refund_policy.calculation_basis: All refund percentages are calculated based on the full project price, not the advance payment.

operational_workflow.onboarding: Client registers via Dashboard -> Submits Service Request -> Consultation -> 50% Advance Payment -> Project Confirmation.

production_stages.name: Review
production_stages.desc: Client feedback and revisions (3 rounds included).

production_stages.name: Handover
production_stages.desc: Final delivery via client dashboard upon settlement of balance.

target_audience: Startup founders looking for rapid market entry.

faq.question: What is required to start my project?
faq.answer: To secure your slot and begin production, a mandatory 50% advance payment is required following your initial consultation.

faq.question: Can I get a refund if I change my mind?
faq.answer: Before project confirmation, we offer a refund of 25% of the total project value. Please note that once a project is confirmed and moves into production, we do not offer refunds.

faq.question: How long does a website take?
faq.answer: The timeline for professional web projects depends on the specific complexity and business days required for your custom solution.
